title: fix: codec measure row follows the runner, not UI state

commit.merge_subject: merge: fix: codec measure row follows the runner, not UI state

description: The Settings row took its busy state from a remembered UI flag, which an Activity recreate resets, while CodecMeasurer (one instance, own thread) kept running. A returning owner saw an idle button, no n/total counter, and a tap answered 'already running'. The row now collects CodecMeasurer.runningFlow (set in start, cleared in the runner's finally) and shows the counter and disables itself from that. Device-checked with always_finish_activities on: counter shown after the Activity was destroyed and reopened.
changed: fix: codec measure row follows the runner, not UI state
